title: libwiretap: add support for signed integer-valued options.
description:
if_tsoffset is one such option in pcapng.

(backported from commit a8eef49a9edc372b1ea1ec06bb7d9cf6b9fa91a5)

notes.body: I couldn't merge this branch: had some issue with GitLab, check my logs...

added 2 commits
  • 1ff9b426 - 1 commit from branch wireshark:release-4.2
  • 0d35b770 - libwiretap: add support for signed integer-valued options.
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/13476/diffs?diff_id=856591010&start_sha=5e56a7f2b81a816b9c1277772783523de5559b95)
